findings.title: Static config seeding has no regression coverage
findings.description: The new first-run behavior reads and parses a project static config, falls back to defaults on missing or invalid input, then persists the selected config in app data. No tests cover these outcomes, so regressions that ignore a valid seed or fail to persist it will go unnoticed. The new keyless-config early return in `sync_to_static` is likewise untested; it can accidentally overwrite the source seed with empty preferences. Add focused coverage for valid, missing/invalid seed files and for saving a config without an API key while preserving the static file.

findings.title: Config source fallback and persistence are untested
findings.description: `loadConfig` now rejects a Tauri config without an API key, fetches the static fallback, and persists a usable static config back through `save_config` in Tauri. No tests exercise the keyless Tauri case, the static success/failure cases, or the save-back behavior, so the intended source precedence and next-launch persistence can regress without detection. Add a test that verifies a keyed static config replaces defaults and is saved to app data, plus cases where missing or keyless static data falls through to localStorage.
